race.comment: PICK 'N' MIX (3) switched stables after failing to fire at Sandown-Hillside, and made an encouraging debut for the Dunn/Bishop stable here 3 weeks ago, finishing second. She had won a trial prior, and will be spot-on for this assignment, especially with 2kg less to carry. Rochelle Milnes sticks with her, and so do we. OUR DIVINYL (6) cops a wide gate for his resuming run, and he has not had a recent trial. He found some nice form at the end of his last campaign, and if ready, he could add some value to any top 4 combos. SASSY FOR SURE (7) made a winning debut fresh up for the local Trevor Montgomerie stable when cruising home to score by 3 lengths here over this trip. This is not much harder, and with the same weight to carry, she is set to repeat the dose. ANOTHER BRIDE (11) is a progressive mare who clung onto a brave win fresh up here 3 weeks ago, finishing a neck ahead of her rivals. She jumps up in grade, but will drop 4.5kg in weight, making her an each-way threat again.
